title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: Paper Statement and Wire Charges
content:
Two service charges on the Savings & Money Market Accounts family depend on tier: the charge for receiving statements on paper, with the age at which owners stop paying it, and the charges for domestic wires sent from, or wires credited to, the account.

## Charges by tier

| Tier | Paper statement fee per cycle (USD) | Owners at least this age pay no paper fee | Outgoing domestic wire fee, each (USD) | Incoming wire fee, each (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Savings | 0.00 | 65 | 30.00 | 15.00 |
| Statement Savings | 2.00 | 65 | 30.00 | 15.00 |
| Goal Builder Savings | 0.00 | 65 | 30.00 | 15.00 |
| Money Market Account | 2.00 | 65 | 30.00 | 15.00 |
| Premier Money Market | 0.00 | 65 | 20.00 | 0.00 |
| Private Client Money Market | 0.00 | 65 | 10.00 | 0.00 |

## How the columns apply

- The paper charge attaches to a statement cycle in which the account's statement delivery is paper when that cycle closes; the exemption age is measured at the same moment.
- Each wire, out or in, carries its own charge at the rate in its column.
- A figure of 0.00 means nothing is charged for that item on that tier.

## Illustrations (hypothetical owners)

**A 70-year-old Money Market Account owner receives paper statements.** The age reaches 65, so no paper charge applies.

**A Premier Money Market owner sends one domestic wire and receives one.** The outgoing wire costs 20.00; the incoming wire costs nothing on that tier.
